abilities.name: Shield Overload
abilities.description: After taking damage while below 75% Health, Artanis gains a 365 point Shield for 5 seconds. Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Shield Overload by 4 seconds.; 24; trait

fields.notes: Shield applies after the damage that triggered Shield Overload is applied to Artanis's Health. However, Artanis will not die if Shield Overload is off cooldown, and no "overkill" damage will carry over to this Shield.

abilities.name: Blade Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward and deal 63 damage to enemies, then return and deal 171 damage. Every enemy hit reduces the cooldown on Shield Overload by 1 second, and Heroes by 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Both forward and backward dash grant Shield Overload cooldown reduction. Hitting an enemy at the very peak of the dash only damages with backward dash damage.

abilities.name: Twin Blades
abilities.description: Artanis's next Basic Attack immediately causes him to charge a short distance and strike the enemy 2 times.

fields.notes: Activating this Ability immediately resets Artanis's Basic Attack timer. Cooldown starts once the Ability is triggered by Basic Attacking an enemy. Twin Blades can be triggered while Rooted, but it doesn't dash.

abilities.name: Phase Prism
abilities.description: Fire a Phase Prism that deals 66 damage to Heroes and swaps Artanis's position with theirs. Hitting a Hero also grants Artanis Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Can be used during Blade Dash.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Clamping, Daze, Displacement, Skillshot, Stationary channel, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Enemies can be swapped over terrain and enemy Structures, but not through allied Structures.

abilities.name: Suppression Pulse
abilities.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.; 50; 40; heroic

abilities.name: Purifier Beam
abilities.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.; 70; 65; heroic

fields.notes: Reveals the target for 10 seconds upon cast. Hits all enemies in its radius, including Heroes and Structures.

talents.name: Reactive Parry
talents.description: Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%. Stores up to 2 charges.

fields.notes: Twin Blades grants a charge on each attack. Blade Dash grants a charge for each Hero hit on both the initial dash and return. Does not stack with other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%. Stores up to 2 charges.

talents.name: Amateur Opponent
talents.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Artanis's Basic Attack damage with Twin Blades.

_raw_fields: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

talents.description: questonly Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Basic Attack damage by 0.1%. Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Artanis's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: questonly Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Basic Attack damage by 0.1%. Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

talents.name: Shield Battery
talents.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active. Passive Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 0.3125 seconds every 0.25 seconds while it is active.
